method: offline neural machine translation plus editorial exact-source glossary and source-aware terminology corrections

model.attribution: Jörg Tiedemann and Santhosh Thottingal. OPUS-MT — Building open translation services for the World. EAMT 2020. Lisbon, Portugal.

chineseScripts.simplified: neural translation target cmn_Hans, normalized with OpenCC t2s
chineseScripts.traditional: OpenCC s2t conversion of simplified result; no independent localization review

descriptionPolicy: First official source sentence or at most 600 source characters. Full source remains separately stored. No invented synopsis when source missing.
qualityPolicy: Unofficial machine-assisted translation. All courses marked needs-human-review. Maintain editable title/description glossaries. Structural checks do not certify semantic correctness.
